meta.title: Performance optimizations and code quality improvements for GSY GitHub App Flutter
meta.body_summary: Comprehensive performance optimizations: widget const constructors, StatelessWidget conversions, singleton patterns, database init improvements, logger tweaks; reverted non-essential file changes per maintainer feedback, keeping only core widget and DB optimizations.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot made broad optimizations; maintainer requested reverting 6 files, then merged after scope reduction without performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1400 changed lines across 17 files, this is a medium-to-large edit by absolute volume, though many changes were later reverted per maintainer request. It fits a wide-ranging performance refactor that was accepted after scope trimming to core widget and DB tweaks.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer CarGuo instructed not to change .gitignore, OPTIMIZATIONS.md, lib/app.dart (specific section), lib/common/logger.dart, lib/common/utils/common_utils.dart, pubspec.yaml, and requested reverting all those changes.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved Flutter app performance via const constructors, singleton patterns, database init optimizations, etc.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent made many changes, some of which were unwanted by the maintainer (e.g., .gitignore, pubspec.yaml, logger). The maintainer trimmed the scope, indicating that the agent over-delivered changes that were not performance-related in the maintainer's view. Human judgment was needed to filter acceptable changes.

detection_detail.code_reading: CarGuo reviewed the PR diff and listed six items to revert: .gitignore, OPTIMIZATIONS.md, specific code in lib/app.dart, logger, common_utils, pubspec.yaml.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after measurements; only narrative claims and code-level best practices.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the maintainer's comment, Copilot committed a fix that reverted the specified files and removed OPTIMIZATIONS.md, leaving only the acceptable widget and DB optimizations. The PR was then merged.

core_change_summary.description: Across multiple commits, Copilot added const constructors, converted StatefulWidget to StatelessWidget, implemented singleton patterns for HttpManager and SqlManager, optimized database initialization with completer, made logger debug-aware, cleaned pubspec.yaml, added lint rules, and added OPTIMIZATIONS.md. After maintainer feedback, reverted changes to .gitignore, app.dart (Future.delayed block), logger, common_utils, pubspec.yaml, and removed OPTIMIZATIONS.md.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Several files (.gitignore, app.dart Future.delayed block, logger, common_utils, pubspec.yaml) were initially changed but reverted per maintainer request; OPTIMIZATIONS.md was removed entirely.
change_trajectory: First optimization commit: widget const constructors, analysis_options.yaml lint rules, initial api.dart singleton changes.
Second optimization commit: further widgets (gsy_input_widget, gsy_title_bar), error page, config, pubspec cleanup.
Third commit: database optimizations (SqlManager, SqlProvider), logger changes, added OPTIMIZATIONS.md.
After maintainer feedback, revert commit: removed all unwanted changes, restored original files, removed OPTIMIZATIONS.md.

review_signals.summary: Requested to revert .gitignore, OPTIMIZATIONS.md, parts of lib/app.dart, logger, common_utils, pubspec.yaml.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot reverted all requested files and removed OPTIMIZATIONS.md.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed all revert actions, keeping only widget and DB optimizations.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with broad optimizations across 17 files.
Maintainer CarGuo commented (~35 minutes later) requesting reverts on 6 items.
Copilot responded ~9 minutes later with a revert commit addressing all points.
PR merged about 34 minutes later without further review.
